matrix.name: State
matrix.description: Current-state organizer. What you currently are / have / do. Ingests Catalyst (perturbation) from the environment, digests it, produces Experience (state-update). Holds entry-types: Pattern (recurring behavior), Threshold (boundary), Foundation (load-bearing structure). Status: Active → Evolving → Archived. Lesser cycle currency flow: Catalyst in → Experience out.

potentiator.name: Possibility
potentiator.description: Latent-state generator. What you could become / are reaching for. Ingests Experience, digests it, produces refined Catalyst (the next question). Daily-logs live here: Activity, Subjective, Relational, Systemic, Diet, Financial, Observation. Future-pull entry-types: Goal, Vision, Aspiration. Status: Raw → Digesting → Crystallized. Lesser cycle currency flow: Experience in → Catalyst out.

significator.name: Identity
significator.description: Persistent identity-pattern. Who you ARE — values, principles, purpose. Lives in BOTH cycles (lesser accumulation + greater transformation). Ingests Transformation (frame-change pressure), emits Choice (directional commitment). Entry-types: Purpose, Value, Principle, Identity-Statement, Pillar, Strategic-Ideal. The `Holon Type` property (Donor/Acceptor/Sharer/Multivalent/Noble) is derived from the Valence Signature YAML. Status: Draft → Active → Evolving → Archived. Greater cycle currency flow: Transformation in → Choice out.

greatway.name: World
greatway.description: Operating environment — your world. People, projects, places, goals. Ingests Choice (committed directionality), produces Transformation (next frame-change pressure). Operational entry-types: Annual Goal, Quarterly Goal, Goal, Project, Task, System, Resource, Sprint, Milestone, Budget, Campaign, Content. External-holon entry-types (other people/orgs in your world): Person, Group, Community, Organization, Network, Movement, Place. Status: Future → Ideation → Paused → Active → Done → Cancelled. Greater cycle currency flow: Choice in → Transformation out.

nexus.name: Process
nexus.description: Contact-boundary where all 4 currencies (Catalyst/Experience/Transformation/Choice) transmute. The shared membrane between the lesser and greater cycles. The `Kind` select tags which currency an entry currently carries. Entry-types: Opportunity, Insight, Reflection, Integration, Pattern, Risk, Directive, Decision, Crisis, Transformation-Event, Note (Catalyst-kind), Knowledge-Atom (Experience-kind), Knowledge-Category (Experience-kind). Status: 💡 Identified → ✅ Activated → 🏆 Capitalized → 🧊 Archived.
